# truefoundry_slack_account (Resource)

Manages a TrueFoundry Slack provider account carrying notification channel integrations (incoming webhooks and bot tokens), applied as a `provider-account/slack` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`. Existing accounts can be imported by their FQN, e.g. `terraform import truefoundry_slack_account.example my-tenant:slack:my-account`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Slack notification channels: an incoming webhook and a bot token,
# both stored as TrueFoundry secret references.
resource "truefoundry_slack_account" "notifications" {
  name = "slack-webhooks"

  webhooks = [
    {
      name        = "team-ai-foundation"
      webhook_url = "my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets:secret-store:vault::slack/team-ai-foundation/value"
    },
  ]

  bots = [
    {
      name                = "alerts-bot"
      bot_token           = "my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets:secret-store:vault::slack/alerts-bot/value"
      authorized_subjects = ["team:everyone"]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Slack account (3-32 characters, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens). Changing it replaces the account.

### Optional

- `bots` (Attributes List) Slack bot notification channels. At least one webhook or bot is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bots))
- `webhooks` (Attributes List) Slack incoming webhook notification channels. At least one webhook or bot is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks))

### Read-Only

- `fqn` (String) Fully qualified name of the Slack account.
- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the Slack account.

<a id="nestedatt--bots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bots`

Required:

- `bot_token` (String, Sensitive) Slack bot token. Accepts TrueFoundry secret references (recommended); the control plane returns it as stored, so drift is detected.
- `name` (String) Name identifying this notification channel.

Optional:

- `authorized_subjects` (List of String) Subjects allowed to use this notification channel, as `<user_type>:<username>` FQNs.


<a id="nestedatt--webhooks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhooks`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name identifying this notification channel.
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) Slack incoming webhook URL. Accepts TrueFoundry secret references (recommended); the control plane returns it as stored, so drift is detected.

Optional:

- `authorized_subjects` (List of String) Subjects allowed to use this notification channel, as `<user_type>:<username>` FQNs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Slack accounts are imported by their FQN: <tenant>:slack:<name>.
terraform import truefoundry_slack_account.notifications my-tenant:slack:slack-webhooks
```
